test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian musicians is known as 'Pancham Da'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Dev Barman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahul Dev Barman:-**

 
 
• He was a versatile music composer who worked in Bollywood films from the 1960s to the 1990s.
 
• He is known for his unique style of **blending Indian classical **music with **western music.**
 
• **He is known as "Pancham Da" in the music industry.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Dev Barman:-**

 
 
• He was** **Rahul Dev Barman's father and also a** famous music composer.**
 
 
 
• **Kishore Kumar:-**
 
 
• He was a** playback singer and actor**, not a music composer.
 
 
 
• **Nitin Mukesh:-**
 
 
• He is a **playback singer.**
 
• **He is a son of Mukesh Kumar.**
